issues.detail: The Greek 'το βδελυγμα της ερημωσεως' (the abomination of desolation) is a direct object of the verb 'ιδητε' (you shall see). The Vietnamese translation 'đã được nói bởi' (which was spoken by) incorrectly attributes the phrase as a quote/statement from Daniel, rather than the subject of the vision/action being seen.

The Greek 'το ρηθεν υπο δανιηλ του προφητου' refers to 'that which was [spoken/written] by the prophet Daniel'. The Vietnamese translation 'đứng ở nơi không nên' (standing in a place that shouldn't) misinterprets the prepositional phrase or context; it fails to capture that the abomination is what was spoken/written by Daniel.
